coverage.note: Valid only when the llama-server log covers exactly the analysed window; llama-server lines carry no wall-clock timestamp, so releases are joined to backend task segments in log order (a proxy line's explicit llama_task_id/slot_id takes precedence when present).

abandoned_prefill_windows.note: Valid only when the llama-server log covers exactly the analysed window; llama-server lines carry no wall-clock timestamp, so releases are joined to backend task segments in log order (a proxy line's explicit llama_task_id/slot_id takes precedence when present).

rules.capacity: no other tenant and an honest cold price (priced ratio >10%): the GPU could not deliver the priced prefill inside the deadline
rules.occupancy: another tenant occupied the slot pool during the dispatch window: a lease_extended_during_prefill from a DIFFERENT session, or a different session's provider=local stream finishing inside the window, or a status poll reporting local_in_flight_requests>=2
rules.predicted-warmth: no other tenant, and admission priced <=10% of the prompt as new compute (a warmth prediction), while the evidence contradicts that price: either the backend reported NO prefill progress at all inside the 120 s window, or the same prompt cluster measured a re-prefill >=4x the priced compute

backend_prefill_accounting.note: Valid only when the llama-server log covers exactly the analysed window; llama-server lines carry no wall-clock timestamp.
